title: CardDAV contacts
author: Atlas core
description: Use a CardDAV address book from a process — iCloud, Nextcloud, ownCloud, mailbox.org, Posteo, Infomaniak, Fastmail, Synology, SOGo, Radicale, Baïkal and most mail providers' — with the operations and the contact of the Google Contacts Worker: find a contact by e-mail address, phone number or a custom field such as a customer number, read, search, list, create, update or delete contacts, and put a group such as Kunden on one or take it off. A model names the Worker and the operation; the server's URL and the account's username and app-specific password live in the Worker and the vault and reach only the worker (ADR-0490). A contact is one flat object: email, phone, organization, address, birthday, notes, fields (the card's X- properties by name) and groups (CATEGORIES, or Apple's group cards for iCloud and Fastmail). An update keeps every property it does not change, a photo included. Find reads the address book and compares exactly, and a repeated create finds the contact the first round made instead of making a second. A missing contact carries the code CARDDAV_CONTACT_NOT_FOUND and is thrown as a BPMN error when the process catches it.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured CardDAV Worker (Console → Workers) whose address book the task uses, never a credential. The attribute behind this field is spelled connector like its siblings'.

choices.name: Find contacts (e-mail, phone or custom field)

properties.label: Contact (read, update, delete, groups)
properties.description: The contact by the id a read, a find or a create answered with (…vcf), e.g. =kunde.id.

properties.label: Query (find, search)
properties.description: Find: an e-mail address or a phone number, compared exactly — or a custom field's value. Search: text contained in a name, the organization, an e-mail address or a phone number.

properties.label: Custom field (find)
properties.description: Optional. Compare the query with this custom field, e.g. Kundennummer (the vCard property X-Kundennummer), instead of with the e-mail addresses and phone numbers.

properties.label: Group (groups; optional on find and list)
properties.description: A group by its name, e.g. Kunden. With group vCards (iCloud, Fastmail) it must exist; with CATEGORIES a group exists by being on a contact.

properties.label: Contact values (create, update)
properties.description: A JSON object with displayName, givenName, familyName, email, emails, phone, phones, organization, jobTitle, department, address, addresses, birthday, notes, fields and — on create — groups. A string starting with = is a FEEL expression. null changes nothing, "" clears; email, phone and address change the preferred entry, emails, phones and addresses replace the list.

properties.label: Contact variable (create, update)
properties.description: Instead of the values above: a process variable holding the contact object.

properties.label: Maximum results (find, search, list)
properties.description: Find and list fail above it rather than return a short list (defaults 100 and 500); the search returns its first matches up to it (default 10, at most 100).

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives the contact or the list of contacts. Delete and the two group operations return nothing, and the compiler refuses a result variable on them.
